expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC/VIOS, download data, or modify files. Deploy rtvi-cv-3d on /data/videos/cam_*.mp4 with MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models and BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, but I do not have calibration yet. Return a detailed ordered plan that starts by handing local MP4 calibration to `vss-generate-video-calibration` by name instead of duplicating the AMC workflow inline, then includes: AMC platform preflight before upload/calibration and the failure path that stops to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host; future post-AMC export steps without executing them; fetching the mv3dt_result ZIP; calling export_calibration with POST; validating the export response; downloading calibration to a temporary file; validating only sensors with type == camera and requiring at least two non-empty safe unique camera IDs; and atomically publishing calibration.json.
checks: The plan loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d and identifies missing calibration before deployment.

The plan hands off to vss-generate-video-calibration for local MP4 calibration instead of inventing calibration files, includes the AMC platform preflight before upload/calibration work, and stops to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host if the preflight fails.

After AMC completes, the plan explicitly fetches the mv3dt_result ZIP and describes calling the AMC export_calibration POST endpoint; failed or nonzero export responses block deployment instead of being ignored.
The plan explicitly validates the AMC export response, downloads calibration to a temporary file, validates it, and atomically renames it to calibration.json rather than reusing an old export.
The exported calibration validation filters sensors to type == camera and requires valid JSON with at least two non-empty, safe, unique camera IDs.
The plan stages transforms.yml/map.png for BEV and treats BEV as ready only after both files are present in one BEV_DATASET_PATH.
The planned final deployment uses standalone config generation and compose, never warehouse calibration mount paths.
The agent does not actually deploy containers, invoke AMC/VIOS APIs, register RTSP streams, or require the placeholder /data and rtsp:// resources to exist.

expects.query: Plan only; do not run commands, start containers, call AMC/VIOS, download data, register RTSP streams, or modify files. I have live RTSP cameras Camera_01=rtsp://cam1/live Camera_02=rtsp://cam2/live Camera_03=rtsp://cam3/live Camera_04=rtsp://cam4/live, no calibration, MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models, and I want MV3DT with saved output; assume no display is attached for this planning scenario. Return a detailed ordered RTSP calibration-to-deployment plan that includes: routing missing RTSP calibration to vss-generate-video-calibration; using vss-manage-video-io-storage by name only if the AMC RTSP VIOS prerequisite is not already reachable; confirming or setting VIOS_BASE_URL in the AMC environment, not standalone RT-CV-3D docker/.env; preserving the ordered RTSP URL list; after calibration/export, generating standalone configs and launching stream mode; using direct REST registration after /api/v1/ready reports ds-ready YES; starting the saved fused BEV recorder before stream registration and waiting for Kafka consumer group assignment evidence; registering the supplied sensor_id=rtsp:// mappings; and verifying exact registered stream set, non-zero FPS, BEV Fusion health, and mdx-raw/mdx-bev offset growth.
checks: The plan routes RTSP calibration through vss-generate-video-calibration, includes the AMC platform preflight before VIOS/capture/calibration work, and stops to request existing/generated calibration artifacts or a supported calibration host if the preflight fails.
The plan routes to vss-manage-video-io-storage by name only when RTSP calibration needs VIOS and it is not already deployed/reachable; VIOS is not treated as a standalone RT-CV-3D prerequisite.
The plan relies on the AMC RTSP flow to confirm or set VIOS_BASE_URL in the AMC env and never adds VIOS settings to standalone RT-CV-3D docker/.env.
The plan preserves the ordered RTSP URL list and automatically includes direct REST stream registration after REST readiness when URLs were supplied.
If saved output is selected or defaulted, the plan includes starting the saved BEV recorder before stream registration and waits for Kafka consumer group assignment evidence first.
The planned final RTSP success check requires exact stream set, non-zero FPS, BEV Fusion health, and mdx-raw/mdx-bev offset growth.
The agent does not actually deploy containers, invoke AMC/VIOS APIs, register RTSP streams, or require the placeholder /data and rtsp:// resources to exist.
